body:
Please add WOWII Conjecture396 (January2010) with Jonas J. Gebendorfer, *Connected counterexamples to Written on the Wall II Conjecture396*.

Here gamma_2 is 2-domination: every vertex outside D has at least two neighbors in D, with no requirement on selected vertices. Let dd_mode count distinct degree values with maximum frequency; let M be vertices of the smallest such degree; let A3 be vertices of degree at least3. The proposed upper bound is gamma_2 <= dd_mode + |M| + |E(A3,V-A3)| for connected graphs of order>2.

**Explicit graph.** Take six disjoint cliques B_s={b_s,0,...,b_s,s-1}, s=4,...,9. Add exactly five interclique edges b4,0-b5,0; b5,1-b6,0; b6,1-b9,0; b9,1-b7,0; b9,2-b8,0. The part graph is a tree, so the graph is connected; it has39 vertices and121 edges.

Each clique retains at least two vertices with no external neighbors. Any 2-dominating set must contain at least two vertices in each clique: otherwise one of those two private vertices is outside D and has at most one selected neighbor. Conversely two vertices per clique suffice. Hence gamma_2=12.

The degree frequencies at3,...,9 are (3,4,6,8,8,7,3). The two distinct modes are6 and7, each of frequency8; the smallest is6. Thus dd_mode=2 and |M|=8. Minimum degree3 makes the boundary term0. The conjecture says12<=10 and is false. The tied modes avoid relying on the source's convention in the unique-mode case.

The manuscript proves a connected chordal family on39r vertices with gamma_2=12r and RHS=8r+2, giving unbounded additive violation. Fresh exact verification checks the graph, all degree frequencies, private-vertex lower certificates and an explicit optimal set.

Source: [DeLaViña's WOWII archive](https://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/open.html), with linked definitions, and the preserved [public HTML-row dataset](https://gitlab.com/ai-village-agents/village/graffiti-verification/-/blob/main/data/wow2_rows_html.json). Historical O and secondary transcriptions are not a current curator decision. No worldwide first-priority or independent external review is claimed.

The attachment contains the full six manuscripts by Jonas J. Gebendorfer (13 October 2026), a newly reconstructed standard-library verifier, its executed output, preserved source records and a SHA256 manifest. Run `python3 audit_new_manuscripts.py`. This is a fresh diagnostic, not a claim to have recovered or rerun the papers' originally described supplements. Finite checks are not proof premises. OpenAI Codex assisted with source comparison, proof reading, reconstruction and submission under the author's direction.

[Gebendorfer_New_Proofs_Intakes_2026-10-14.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33421512/Gebendorfer_New_Proofs_Intakes_2026-10-14.zip)

14 October 2026: the complete Lean certificate is now available, and the exact statement is submitted in #7320.

Pinned [proof](https://github.com/RhudeJJJJ/formal-conjectures/blob/a95d2f088ec6384d1739aaa115b750ba61b874f8/Proofs/WOWII396Proof.lean), [independent exact-statement/axiom audit](https://github.com/RhudeJJJJ/formal-conjectures/blob/a95d2f088ec6384d1739aaa115b750ba61b874f8/Proofs/WOWII396Audit.lean), and [reproduction instructions](https://github.com/RhudeJJJJ/formal-conjectures/blob/a95d2f088ec6384d1739aaa115b750ba61b874f8/Proofs/README-WOWII396.md).

The kernel checks connectedness, the two tied degree modes, bound 10, and exact 2-domination number 12 for the 39-vertex witness. The lower bound is structural for arbitrary sets. Both files compile without warnings; all nine audited declarations use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The upstream statement module passes lake --wfail build. This is an author-workflow verification; maintainer source/statement review remains pending. The certificate does not formalize the infinite family or claim minimum order.

OpenAI Codex assisted under Jonas J. Gebendorfer's direction.

title: WOWII 396: a connected 39-vertex 2-domination counterexample with unbounded extension
